notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Register description is 'No information at this time', and two web searches found nothing about Black Spring itself. Facts come from four pages: the Register, firelookout.com, Forest Lookouts (quoting a 1957 USGS-described survey station) and the FFLA Montana list (undated). Unknown: build date, design, height, staffing, current condition. Open conflicts: distance and bearing from Lame Deer (firelookout 5 mi NW vs survey 2 mi N and 6 mi W); elevation (Register 3,685 ft vs firelookout 3,692 ft). Record's elevation (1123.2 m) is the Register figure, kept. Access level 'restricted' is our reading of tribal land; the record's 'permission' is not stated by any source read, so please pick the level. No photos: firelookout.com credits a photo by Luke Channer but gives no image URL. Not verified: whether the tower stands today.
